groups: Whole paired wells and quantiles linked; matched technical blocks
eligibility: All finite events with positive FSC-A and SSC-A; at least100 valid events per well. Native negative fluorescence retained. Linear quantiles0.1...0.9 fixed before fitting.
timing: After paired uninduced control well is measured, before observing induced well target. Quantiles0.1–0.9 and cell-line identity are known; no induced fluorescence enters predictors.
selection: Equal block MAE with equal line/quantile observations; smallest coefficient count within1%best; >=5 adaptive hypotheses then two no-gain challenges
exposure: Only sample list and FCS headers inspected. No held fluorescence targets printed before freeze.
